verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox or test environment with data kept separate from production, such as a staging database or isolated test data. The closest items are adjacent: drafts are 'a separate copy of the project with its own chat and preview', remixes are independent copies, and Git branches let you test features. None of these states that production data is isolated. Read-only subagents and read-only database queries limit writes but are not a sandbox environment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
